description: Scaffold a new managed project inside a kensaiapp instance — create the per-project folder tree system/projects/<name>/ (project.md with the Product path binding, agari.md, doctrine/, contexts/CONTEXT_PM.md, and the journey/ folders nemawashi/ (README + the recommended define-the-product seed + unpicked/ + trail/ + drop/), shukuba/ (README + parked/ + trail/), tobiishi/trail/) stamped from the core templates, per kensaiapp_structure.md §2. Use this whenever the user wants to start, register, scaffold, or set up a new project / product engagement in this instance — even if they just say "add a project" or "onboard <product>". It is the step that comes BEFORE the CPO session (which authors the PRD and declares the product's "done"); this creates the management folder that points at the product. Does NOT create the product's docs or code. Do not use for: declaring the product's Agari (project-agari), running a change through the pipeline (the chain), or first-time instance setup (setup-kensaiapp).
